newsitem.title: USA: White House, Congress close to budget detail pact.
newsitem.headline: White House, Congress close to budget detail pact.

text.p: Vice President Al Gore said on Tuesday that the administration and the Congress were very close to putting their recent budget agreement into legislative language for passage by lawmakers.
He made the comments at a news conference on a Clinton administration initiative to clean up polluted industrial sites.
The House Budget Committee said earlier it would consider the fiscal 1998 budget resolution Wednesday. The committee will discuss any amendments offered to the budget framework.
The White House and congressional leaders reached agreement on May 2 on a broad outline of a plan to balance the budget by 2002.
